chapter: New York working life and business
title: Typical wages
summary: About $100-125 a week plus recording sessions.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Can I ask what the typical wages might have been like playing at the Metropole or the Five Spot?

Well nobody got rich you know. I don’t even remember. I guess I didn’t even worry about how much money I was making you know. I guess I did not. I guess $125 a week maybe or something like that. Somewhere in that area, $100, $125 a week. But I was also busy doing recording sessions and that added on to the overall monetary figure.
